item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re
html=Path('index.html').read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.links=[]; self.fields=[]; self.labels=[]; self.h1=0
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='h1':self.h1+=1
  if tag in ('a','use') and a.get('href','').startswith('#'):self.links.append(a['href'][1:])
  if tag in ('input','select'):self.fields.append(a.get('id'))
  if tag=='label':self.labels.append(a.get('for'))
c=Check();c.feed(html)
assert len(c.ids)==len(set(c.ids)),'Duplicate IDs'
assert c.h1==1,'Expected one h1'
assert all(link in c.ids for link in c.links),'Broken internal link'
assert all(field in c.labels for field in c.fields),'Unlabeled form field'
Path('/tmp/tidepool-inline-new.js').write_text(re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',html,re.S).group(1))
print('HTML structure: unique IDs, valid anchors, one h1, and all form fields labeled.')
PY
node --check /tmp/tidepool-inline-new.js"
